title: Base64 Codec
description: Encodes UTF-8 text or hex bytes to Base64 (standard, or URL-safe unpadded with urlSafe) and decodes Base64 in either alphabet (padding optional, whitespace ignored). Returns valid, operation, encoded (canonical padded standard form when decoding), text (null if not valid UTF-8), hex and byteLength. Malformed input returns valid:false with error and message.
